    RcChannels.released(int channelCount)
    A frame that releases every one of channelCount channels back to the RC radio — stored as the domain RELEASE sentinel throughout; wireValue(int) is what turns that into EXTENSION_RELEASE for the channels past BASE_CHANNEL_COUNT once this frame actually reaches the wire.

    ManualControlService.send(ManualControlService.ManualControlLink link, RcChannels channels)
    Overwrites link's latest-wins mailbox with channels and, when the wire ceiling has already elapsed, schedules an immediate one-shot transmit rather than letting the frame wait for the next tick (see the class javadoc's two-rates section).
